claim: Extend the write-flow front door to the todo collection: a sanctioned entry point for flipping a materialized item's status (open -> done, with discharge notes). The belief half of the gap closed with mix cb.evidence (b522); the todo half remains - every t-item status flip is still a hand-rolled script against todos.json, and the flip is half of every discharge.

evidence.detail: Two specimens bracket the gap: the t0013 flip went through raw python (the ensure_ascii incident's other half), and the t0014 flip went through an ad-hoc mix run -e script in the very session that built the evidence front door - the b522 discharge could sanction its own evidence append but not its own todo flip. Preflight 2026-06-12: 0 contract, 2 non-contract flags (b494, b498), both bare tag_overlap with no semantic contact - b498 (canon changes through the write flow) is supportive in spirit; reviewed per b055 and proceeded.

Specimens nine and ten by the running count: the t0015/t0016 status flips in the b519 discharge went through a hand-rolled .exs (CB.JSON read, Jason pretty encode, write_atomic_raw) - serialization pinned by using the sink's own modules, but still an ad-hoc script in the session that had just used mix cb.evidence for the belief half of the same discharge. The asymmetry is now the routine shape of every close: sanctioned append on the node, hand-rolled flip on the todo.

Discharged 2026-06-12 (materialized t0017): CB.Todos now owns the collection's serialization - tolerant read, atomic pretty write, strict open->done close that keeps materialization notes and appends discharge notes - with mix cb.todo.close fronting it (dry-run default, --notes required, refusals on unknown ids and non-open status) and the materializer's JSON sink rerouted through the same store, so the append and flip paths share one encoding and the ensure_ascii drift class is closed by construction on this collection too. Smoke-verified on a temp copy of the live file: non-ascii notes landed unescaped, untouched records byte-identical. t0017's own flip was the front door's first production run.

todos.action: Provide the todo-flip front door: CB.Todos store owning the collection's read/atomic write/close (strict open -> done, materialization notes kept with discharge notes appended as a new paragraph), the mix cb.todo.close task fronting it (dry-run default, --notes required, --todos override, refusals on unknown ids and non-open status), and the materializer's JSON sink rerouted through the same store so the append path and the flip path share one serialization
